label: Reflexive existence-requirement versus strict dependence for being: scope and order laws
summary: Issue #1593. (1) Scope conflict made exact: under the OPEN reflexivity statement, unrestricted asymmetry of DependsForBeing fails on every inhabited domain (bf6cb784); two Boolean models (identity, and the two-element order) are reflexive and distinct-nonmutual but not asymmetric (0ccf914c). No Lean contradiction exists in the corpus; the primitive fixes no self-relation law. Reflexivity is a live reading because the bare counterfactual clause of the definition, apart from its agent-cause qualification, instantiates the counterfactual identity law (valid in any selection semantics whose selected worlds satisfy the antecedent, impossible-worlds semantics included), while the agent-cause qualification and paradigm are strict; the definition read whole supports both readings. (2) Senses: no new TERM_n. Distinct nonmutuality is exactly asymmetry of DistinctEdge D (lake-checked lemma); interpreted strict explanatory dependence is not separately represented (sense 2 of 23dd6f32 is formal strict ground on uninterpreted atoms; grounds is joined to D only by OPEN bridges) and no result here needs it; modal entailment is ModalRequiresExistence (d7f66ca4). Paraphrases of the distinct and asymmetric statements and the DEF-DEPENDS-FOR-BEING note were corrected to record the fork. (3) Order laws tested separately: priority irreflexivity from the requirement bridge alone (1ee45a81); priority transitivity from both OPEN bridges plus OPEN transitivity of D (938bfd7f); strict-part correspondence only under the bridges (lake-checked lemmas); a Fin 3 direct-edge chain shows transitivity of D cannot be dropped, and a reciprocal pair has empty strict part (a79850a6). (4) Root: the distinct premise keeps its meaning and is available on both readings; the asymmetric premise only on the strict reading. Consumer sibling actualGroundingAsymmetricViaDistinct (distinct premise + irreflexive grounding) is Comparator-checked via d86e618b's config but not registered, because STMT-ACTUAL-GROUNDING-ASYMMETRIC links two WELL_FOUNDEDNESS_AND_ANTI_BRUTE_ROOT senses (c86cc1d1, c57e2682) absent from its Lean type, so any new argument concluding it fails the sense-mixing check. #1590: the unrestricted STMT-ACTUAL-DEPENDENCE-IS-GROUNDING forces self-grounding of every actual concretum under reflexive D (d86e618b); the distinct-relata sibling a8298fbd is proved from it (cc7dd608) with a strengthens relation. Computed frontier: 476 open premises unchanged (339 bare); STMT-SIMPLE-PRIORITY-IS-TRANSITIVE bare -> conclusion of a verified argument from open premises (not established), replaced by bare 09b88101; support alternatives 456 -> 457. Nothing established.
